page.overview:
Who is Finley?

She is at that awkward age where she is a young woman but still has not had her growth spurt yet. Finley believes she will never grow taller and laments that it is awful to be herself sometimes. She doubts that have to deal with such nonsense since they age so fast.

If Link asks who she is, tells the hero her name and says all the other girls are "head over flippers" for except her, as she believes everyone has their own special prince out there waiting for them. When asked about the , explains that it is a location halfway down . She goes on to say that if a letter is sent down the from the and there is a reply, that person will be theirs forever. When questioned about the letter, reveals that she has a pen pal who she communicates with by tossing a letter in a bottle down .

After the has been appeased, Kodah can't find , who apparently told her mother that she was going to find a prince of her own. Because of this, can be found at the , where she asks her to carry her thoughts. When she notices , she asks if he has a wish for the water fairy too, before realizing he does not have a letter. then winders if is a servant of the water fairy. If he agrees with 's statement, she will tell him not to make fun of her just because she is a cute girl. If Link says he is a traveler, Finley will express excitement.

Either way, Finley will request 's help. She asks to follow her love letter, a large container, when she releases it down the to know whoever picks it up. says to report back to her so she can find out what kind of person received it. She explains that she cannot do it herself because her mother does not want her to venture too far. Finley begs to find the person who picks up the letter. then throws the letter into the and asks if he's ready, warning that the letter container breaks easily. This initiates the "".
